tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi mdos bskang mdor bsdus bzhugs/

sgrub mchod skabs mdos bskang mdor bsdus bya bar spro na/ gtor ma bang rim bzhi steng chos 'byung bsnol ma'i thog tu mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dmar gtor gtso 'khor lnga la so so'i mdog mthun gyi nam mkha' 'am dar sna btsug /mtha' skor du nam mkha' mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong gzugs 'gros sna tshogs bcas zan la spar btab pa dang 'bru sna dar sna sogs kyis bskor ba'am/ de las bsdu na chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng sde lnga'i gtor ma dar snas brgyan pa la 'bru dang bza' bcas bskor ba bsham/ gzhung gi mar me'i skong ba rdzogs pa dang*/ mdos byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stong pa'i ngang las mdos gtor rnams/ /ngo bo ye shes rang bzhin la/ /rnam pa snang srid dkyil 'khor kun/ /yongs rdzogs mdos gtor nam mkha' mdzod/ /byed las lha tshogs dgyes skor gyur/ ces dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab/ spro na spyan 'dren mchod bstod sbyar ba'am ma byas kyang rung ste mdos bskang dngos ni/ hūm̐: skye med dbyings kyi nam mkha'i klong*/ /rig gdangs ma 'gags cho 'phrul las/ /srid zhi'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lor shar/ /de dbus rdo rje khros ma nag /rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo yab yum dang*/ /las dang ye shes dhā ki nī/ /'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dgyes dgur spyod pa'i maṇ+ḍa la/ /bde chen rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /yongs rdzogs mdos kyi longs spyod mchog /'dod yon mchog gi gter chen pos/ /rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dgyes par rol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam tshig nyams chag zhi bar mdzod/ nad rims 'byung bzhi'i g.yo 'khrugs zlog /tshe bsod 'khor slob brgyud 'dzin spel/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po'i 'tshe ba chod/ /nye rgyu'i spyod pa'i grogs mdzad nas/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i bar chad sol/

/zhu bde mi rtog ye shes skyed/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hi kro dhī kā lī ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya dhā ka dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bam̐ badz+ra bha ra hī dz+nyā na badz+ra maṇ+ḍal sarba pū dza ma ya hoḥ zhes btags pa ci nus bzlas pas mchod/ de ltar phul bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zag med kyi bde bas dgyes shing 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ bdag dang slob ma'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bsal zhing*/ mchog thun gyi las rab 'byams lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzad par gyur par bsam/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas mthus so/ /zhes nyer mkho'i ched phun tshogs rnam rgyal pas rgyal dbang karma pa'i gsungs las btus pa lags so/ /
